1.web: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
1.asv: Make a joyful noise unto God, all the earth:

2.web: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!
2.asv: Sing forth the glory of his name: Make his praise glorious.

3.web: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
3.asv: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

4.web: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.
4.asv: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; They shall sing to thy name. [Selah

5.web: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
5.asv: Come, and see the works of God; He is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

6.web: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.
6.asv: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot: There did we rejoice in him.

7.web: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.
7.asv: He ruleth by his might for ever; His eyes observe the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. [Selah

8.web: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
8.asv: Oh bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of his praise to be heard;

9.web: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
9.asv: Who holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.

10.web: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
10.asv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

11.web: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
11.asv: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.

12.web: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.
12.asv: Thou didst cause men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

13.web: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
13.asv: I will come into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,

14.web: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
14.asv: Which my lips uttered, And my mouth spake, when I was in distress.

15.web: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.
15.asv: I will offer unto thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. [Selah

16.web: Come, and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
16.asv: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

17.web: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.
17.asv: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.

18.web: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
18.asv: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear:

19.web: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
19.asv: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

20.web: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
20.asv: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me.
